title: Debug Frame Length Parser
shortDescription: Fix a C frame parser with endian and bounds-checking bugs.

objectives: Fix a C frame parser with endian and bounds-checking bugs

hints.nudge: Which checks must happen before a byte can be read?
hints.approach: Trace the shortest valid frame and the first truncated frame. Reconstruct the declared length using the stated byte order, then compare it with the available payload without allowing arithmetic wraparound.

templates.notes: The starter is intentionally wrong. Use printf while running samples.

visibleCases.name: valid short frame
visibleCases.displayInput:
uint8_t frame[] = {0xA5u, 0x00u, 0x03u, 0x11u, 0x22u, 0x33u};
int rc = frame_payload_len(frame, sizeof(frame));

visibleCases.name: reject bad sync
visibleCases.displayInput:
uint8_t frame[] = {0x5Au, 0x00u, 0x01u, 0x99u};
int rc = frame_payload_len(frame, sizeof(frame));
visibleCases.explanation: Sync must be checked before parsing length.

visibleCases.name: reject truncated payload
visibleCases.displayInput:
uint8_t frame[] = {0xA5u, 0x00u, 0x04u, 0x11u, 0x22u, 0x33u};
int rc = frame_payload_len(frame, sizeof(frame));
visibleCases.explanation: Declared payload length must fit inside the buffer.
